ui.krizaka-ui.gap: Krizaka UI only, no hand-made bar, no hard-coded colour; the one « A Krizaka product » footer is missing in the app.

mobile.build.na: No mobile app in the QA Dev preview (AGENTS.md, decision of 2026-10-17): the web app is phone-first and checked at 360 px.

mobile.ux-review.na: mobile.build is not applicable: there is no native app; the phone screens are reviewed in ux.ia-review.

ops.cost.gap: The QA app is one 5 USD/month service (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md#cost); the organisation's cloud total is above the 100 USD target (see the budget issue).

admin.gated.na: No Krizaka operator console exists yet: the organisation's own console (members: pause, restore) is part of the app and is not an operator task; the QA app is operated through the platform and the repository.
